print_templates.list.title: List print templates
print_templates.list.description: Page through print templates: the platform sees every global template; a tenant sees its own templates by default and, with the Global scope, the enabled global templates open to tenants.
print_templates.get.title: Get a print template
print_templates.get.description: Get a print template with its design JSON; a tenant can read a global template only when it is enabled and open to tenants.
print_templates.resolve.title: Resolve a print template by code
print_templates.resolve.description: Resolve the enabled template to print by code and scope: for a tenant, Auto takes the tenant's own template first and falls back to an open global template; results are cached for 30 minutes.
print_templates.create.title: Create a print template
print_templates.create.description: Create a print template on the caller's side (a global template on the platform, which also needs global management): the code is unique on the side and cannot change, the data source must be registered, and the JSON must be schemaVersion 1 with pages.
print_templates.update.title: Update a print template
print_templates.update.description: Update the name, data source, design JSON, tenant access, order and remark of a template on the caller's side (the code cannot change); send back the concurrency stamp you read.
print_templates.set_status.title: Enable or disable a print template
print_templates.set_status.description: Enable or disable a template on the caller's side; send back the concurrency stamp you read, and a remark, when given, replaces the current one.
print_templates.delete.title: Delete print templates
print_templates.delete.description: Delete disabled templates on the caller's side in a batch; templates still enabled are refused one by one.
print_data_sources.list.title: List print data sources
print_data_sources.list.description: List the registered print data sources (field contracts and sample JSON) for the designer and for printing; either the read or the use permission on templates is enough.
printing.template.no_usable: No usable print template '{code}' in scope {scope}; check the code, the scope, whether it is enabled and whether the global template is open to tenants.
printing.template.code_taken: A print template with code '{code}' already exists on this side.
printing.template.enabled: Disable the print template before deleting it.
printing.template.global_manage_required: Maintaining global print templates requires the global management permission.
printing.template.global_not_open: The global print template '{code}' is not open to tenants.
printing.template_json.syntax: The print template is not valid JSON.
printing.template_json.root: The root of the print template JSON must be an object.
printing.template_json.schema_version: Unsupported print template format: schemaVersion must be the number 1.
printing.template_json.pages: The print template needs a non-empty pages array.
printing.template_json.page: Item {index} of pages must be an object.
printing.data_source.unregistered: Print data source '{code}' is not registered.
printing.scope.invalid: The platform side has no tenant templates; use the Auto or Global scope.
openapi.groups.printing.name: Printing
openapi.groups.printing.description: Print templates of the platform and tenants, resolution by code, and the print data source catalog.
openapi.tags.print_templates.name: Print templates
openapi.tags.print_templates.description: Create, read, update, delete, enable and resolve print templates; the platform maintains global templates and tenants maintain their own and use the open global ones.
openapi.tags.print_data_sources.name: Print data sources
openapi.tags.print_data_sources.descript: The catalog of print data sources registered by the modules: field contracts and sample data.
